Experience Westcliffe
Nestled in the heart of the Sangre de Cristo Mountains, Westcliffe is a quaint town that embodies the perfect blend of natural beauty, artistic expression, and small-town charm. Our boutique hotel is the perfect base for exploring this enchanting community, where you can immerse yourself in the rich culture, stunning scenery, and vibrant artistic scene. From numerous galleries and studios to outdoor recreational opportunities like hiking, biking, and fishing, Westcliffe has something for everyone. Take in the breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and discover the many hidden gems that make this town a truly special place.

Where comfort meets convenience! The Main Suite is the perfect retreat for those looking for a peaceful stay in Westcliffe. The Main Suite features a cozy queen bed, a warm fireplace, Roku TV, and a spacious living area, perfect for relaxing after a day of exploring the town. Step outside on your private front porch and take in the sights and sounds of Main Street, where you can watch town parades and other activities up close. With its central location on Main Street, you'll be right in the heart of the action. Book your stay today and experience the ultimate comfort and convenience in Westcliffe!
